visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a light beard wears a denim jacket over a white shirt, appearing in a bright studio environment with white shelving units in the background. He holds a black handheld beauty device with a glowing ring while expressive yellow and white text overlays pop onto the screen. (2) The scene transitions to a series of extreme close-ups of the man's facial skin, specifically his cheeks and under-eye area, demonstrating the application of a handheld beauty device with a metallic circular head. Animated diagrams and text labels highlight different light modes (green, blue, red) and technical skin absorption visuals. (3) A promotional insert features a young woman with long black hair holding a pink version of the beauty device, followed by shots of various pink and white skincare bottles and jars labeled with brand logos. The man reappears, demonstrating the application of a gel-like skincare patch to his cheek which becomes transparent over time. (4) Detailed product shots of the Medicube PDRN line are shown, including serums and toner pads. The man uses the device over the skincare products on his face, while graphic illustrations of skin layers and absorption percentages appear beside him. (5) The man returns to a medium shot, enthusiastically gesturing toward the camera while holding the beauty device and the skincare set, surrounded by sparkles and large promotional text overlays indicating a special discount or event. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice shouting a greeting over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop track. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the first cut as he mentions sales numbers with a rising, excited pitch. (2) As the technical explanation begins, the speaker's tone remains energetic but more articulate. A 'pop' sound effect occurs when a text graphic appears. The background music maintains a steady 4/4 beat with synthetic bass and bright percussion. (3) A 'splash' sound effect is audible when liquid skincare is demonstrated visually, followed by several 'ding' sounds as different modes are listed. The voice maintains a high arousal level, emphasizing the brand name with a forceful, authoritative delivery. (4) The final segment features a series of rapid 'whoosh' and 'sparkle' SFX as promotional deals are mentioned. The male voice reaches its peak volume and intensity during the call-to-action, while the music continues at a consistent tempo until a sharp final cut.
